options.content:
## Quality & latency comparison (Postgres)
Aggregates from `evaluation_metrics`. **Quality story:** `rougeL` (did RAG help?). **Device story:** `time_to_response` and `tokens_per_sec`. `quality_score` is a blend that can fall on RAG when hit@k is 0 even if overlap improved. Speedup = CPU seconds ÷ GPU seconds.

panels.title: Run — what you are looking at
panels.description: The selected run's identity, per device leg. `run_id` matches `results/runs/<run_id>/` on disk. Rows written before run identity was added to the schema have no run_id and are excluded from every panel here.

targets.rawSql:
-- One row per device leg of the selected run. Rows written before run_id
-- existed have no run and never appear here.
SELECT run_id,
       MIN(run_started_at) AS run_started_at,
       COALESCE(device, 'unknown') AS device,
       string_agg(DISTINCT COALESCE(runtime, 'transformers'), ', ' ORDER BY COALESCE(runtime, 'transformers')) AS runtimes,
       string_agg(DISTINCT model_name, ', ' ORDER BY model_name) AS models,
       COUNT(DISTINCT sample_id) AS samples,
       COUNT(*) AS answers,
       ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(timestamp) - MIN(timestamp)))::numeric, 1) AS wall_s,
       'results/runs/' || run_id || '/' AS export_folder
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (run_id, approach, sample_id, COALESCE(device, 'unknown'))
         *
  FROM evaluation_metrics
  ORDER BY run_id, approach, sample_id, COALESCE(device, 'unknown'), timestamp DESC
) evaluation_metrics
WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL AND split_part(run_id, '_', 1) || '_' || split_part(run_id, '_', 2) = ${run:sqlstring}
GROUP BY run_id, COALESCE(device, 'unknown')
ORDER BY run_id

SELECT CASE approach
           WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'Baseline'
           WHEN 'baseline_gguf' THEN 'Baseline (GGUF)'
           WHEN 'rag' THEN 'RAG'
           WHEN 'rag_gguf' THEN 'RAG (GGUF)'
           WHEN 'fine_tuned' THEN 'Fine-tuned'
           WHEN 'fine_tuned_with_rag' THEN 'Fine-tuned + RAG'
           ELSE approach END || ' · ' || COALESCE(device, 'unknown')
         || ' (n=' || COUNT(*) || ')' AS series,
       AVG("rougeL") AS rouge_l
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (run_id, approach, sample_id, COALESCE(device, 'unknown'))
         *
  FROM evaluation_metrics
  ORDER BY run_id, approach, sample_id, COALESCE(device, 'unknown'), timestamp DESC
) evaluation_metrics
WHERE "rougeL" IS NOT NULL AND run_id IS NOT NULL AND split_part(run_id, '_', 1) || '_' || split_part(run_id, '_', 2) = ${run:sqlstring}
GROUP BY approach, COALESCE(device, 'unknown')
ORDER BY CASE approach
           WHEN 'baseline' THEN 1
           WHEN 'baseline_gguf' THEN 2
           WHEN 'rag' THEN 3
           WHEN 'rag_gguf' THEN 4
           WHEN 'fine_tuned' THEN 5
           WHEN 'fine_tuned_with_rag' THEN 6
           ELSE 7 END, 1

panels.title: Avg rougeL by approach × device (RAG quality story)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE approach
           WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'Baseline'
           WHEN 'baseline_gguf' THEN 'Baseline (GGUF)'
           WHEN 'rag' THEN 'RAG'
           WHEN 'rag_gguf' THEN 'RAG (GGUF)'
           WHEN 'fine_tuned' THEN 'Fine-tuned'
           WHEN 'fine_tuned_with_rag' THEN 'Fine-tuned + RAG'
           ELSE approach END || ' · ' || COALESCE(device, 'unknown')
         || ' (n=' || COUNT(*) || ')' AS series,
       AVG(COALESCE(time_to_response, generation_time + COALESCE(retrieval_time, 0))) AS time_to_response
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (run_id, approach, sample_id, COALESCE(device, 'unknown'))
         *
  FROM evaluation_metrics
  ORDER BY run_id, approach, sample_id, COALESCE(device, 'unknown'), timestamp DESC
) evaluation_metrics
WHERE generation_time IS NOT NULL AND run_id IS NOT NULL AND split_part(run_id, '_', 1) || '_' || split_part(run_id, '_', 2) = ${run:sqlstring}
GROUP BY approach, COALESCE(device, 'unknown')
ORDER BY CASE approach
           WHEN 'baseline' THEN 1
           WHEN 'baseline_gguf' THEN 2
           WHEN 'rag' THEN 3
           WHEN 'rag_gguf' THEN 4
           WHEN 'fine_tuned' THEN 5
           WHEN 'fine_tuned_with_rag' THEN 6
           ELSE 7 END, 1

panels.title: Avg time to response — lower is better

targets.rawSql:
-- The CPU and GPU legs of one pipeline invocation are separate run_ids
-- (<stamp>_cpu and <stamp>_cuda) that share the <stamp> prefix, so the join key is
-- that prefix plus approach. Joining on approach alone divided one run's CPU latency
-- by a different run's GPU latency — different model, prompts and thread budget — and
-- printed the quotient as a headline speedup.
WITH lat AS (
  SELECT split_part(run_id, '_', 1) || '_' || split_part(run_id, '_', 2) AS run_group,
         approach,
         COALESCE(device, 'unknown') AS device,
         AVG(COALESCE(time_to_response, generation_time + COALESCE(retrieval_time, 0))) AS ttr,
         COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (run_id, approach, sample_id, COALESCE(device, 'unknown'))
         *
  FROM evaluation_metrics
  ORDER BY run_id, approach, sample_id, COALESCE(device, 'unknown'), timestamp DESC
) evaluation_metrics
  WHERE generation_time IS NOT NULL AND run_id IS NOT NULL AND split_part(run_id, '_', 1) || '_' || split_part(run_id, '_', 2) = ${run:sqlstring}
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT CASE c.approach
           WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'Baseline'
           WHEN 'baseline_gguf' THEN 'Baseline (GGUF)'
           WHEN 'rag' THEN 'RAG'
           WHEN 'rag_gguf' THEN 'RAG (GGUF)'
           WHEN 'fine_tuned' THEN 'Fine-tuned'
           WHEN 'fine_tuned_with_rag' THEN 'Fine-tuned + RAG'
           ELSE c.approach END || ' (n=' || c.n || '/' || g.n || ')' AS series,
       (c.ttr / NULLIF(g.ttr, 0)) AS gpu_speedup_x
FROM lat c
JOIN lat g
  ON c.run_group = g.run_group
 AND c.approach = g.approach
WHERE c.device = 'cpu' AND g.device IN ('cuda', 'gpu')
ORDER BY CASE c.approach
           WHEN 'baseline' THEN 1
           WHEN 'baseline_gguf' THEN 2
           WHEN 'rag' THEN 3
           WHEN 'rag_gguf' THEN 4
           WHEN 'fine_tuned' THEN 5
           WHEN 'fine_tuned_with_rag' THEN 6
           ELSE 7 END, 1

panels.title: GPU speedup (CPU time_to_response ÷ GPU) — >1× means GPU faster

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE approach
           WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'Baseline'
           WHEN 'baseline_gguf' THEN 'Baseline (GGUF)'
           WHEN 'rag' THEN 'RAG'
           WHEN 'rag_gguf' THEN 'RAG (GGUF)'
           WHEN 'fine_tuned' THEN 'Fine-tuned'
           WHEN 'fine_tuned_with_rag' THEN 'Fine-tuned + RAG'
           ELSE approach END AS approach,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(device, '') = 'cpu') AS n_cpu,
       AVG(COALESCE(retrieval_time, 0)) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(device, '') = 'cpu') AS retrieval_cpu,
       AVG(generation_time) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(device, '') = 'cpu') AS generation_cpu,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(device, '') IN ('cuda', 'gpu')) AS n_gpu,
       AVG(COALESCE(retrieval_time, 0)) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(device, '') IN ('cuda', 'gpu')) AS retrieval_cuda,
       AVG(generation_time) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(device, '') IN ('cuda', 'gpu')) AS generation_cuda
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (run_id, approach, sample_id, COALESCE(device, 'unknown'))
         *
  FROM evaluation_metrics
  ORDER BY run_id, approach, sample_id, COALESCE(device, 'unknown'), timestamp DESC
) evaluation_metrics
WHERE generation_time IS NOT NULL AND run_id IS NOT NULL AND split_part(run_id, '_', 1) || '_' || split_part(run_id, '_', 2) = ${run:sqlstring}
GROUP BY approach
ORDER BY CASE approach
           WHEN 'baseline' THEN 1
           WHEN 'baseline_gguf' THEN 2
           WHEN 'rag' THEN 3
           WHEN 'rag_gguf' THEN 4
           WHEN 'fine_tuned' THEN 5
           WHEN 'fine_tuned_with_rag' THEN 6
           ELSE 7 END

panels.title: Latency breakdown: retrieval vs generation (CPU / CUDA)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE approach
           WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'Baseline'
           WHEN 'baseline_gguf' THEN 'Baseline (GGUF)'
           WHEN 'rag' THEN 'RAG'
           WHEN 'rag_gguf' THEN 'RAG (GGUF)'
           WHEN 'fine_tuned' THEN 'Fine-tuned'
           WHEN 'fine_tuned_with_rag' THEN 'Fine-tuned + RAG'
           ELSE approach END AS approach,
       COALESCE(device, 'unknown') AS device,
       COUNT(*) AS n_answers,
       ROUND(AVG("rougeL")::numeric, 3) AS avg_rouge_l,
       ROUND(AVG(bert_score)::numeric, 3) AS avg_bert,
       ROUND(AVG(faithfulness)::numeric, 3) AS avg_faithfulness,
       ROUND(AVG(quality_score)::numeric, 3) AS avg_quality,
       ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(time_to_response, generation_time + COALESCE(retrieval_time, 0)))::numeric, 2) AS avg_ttr_sec,
       -- At a handful of questions one slow answer owns the mean, so the
       -- distribution is reported next to it rather than instead of it.
       ROUND((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY COALESCE(time_to_response, generation_time + COALESCE(retrieval_time, 0))))::numeric, 2) AS p50_ttr_sec,
       ROUND((percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY COALESCE(time_to_response, generation_time + COALESCE(retrieval_time, 0))))::numeric, 2) AS p95_ttr_sec,
       ROUND(AVG(tokens_per_sec)::numeric, 2) AS avg_tok_per_sec
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (run_id, approach, sample_id, COALESCE(device, 'unknown'))
         *
  FROM evaluation_metrics
  ORDER BY run_id, approach, sample_id, COALESCE(device, 'unknown'), timestamp DESC
) evaluation_metrics
WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL AND split_part(run_id, '_', 1) || '_' || split_part(run_id, '_', 2) = ${run:sqlstring}
GROUP BY approach, COALESCE(device, 'unknown')
ORDER BY CASE approach
           WHEN 'baseline' THEN 1
           WHEN 'baseline_gguf' THEN 2
           WHEN 'rag' THEN 3
           WHEN 'rag_gguf' THEN 4
           WHEN 'fine_tuned' THEN 5
           WHEN 'fine_tuned_with_rag' THEN 6
           ELSE 7 END, device

panels.title: Selected run vs comparison run — headline deltas
panels.description: Both legs come from their own run, matched on approach and device. Empty when the two runs share no approach/device pair.

targets.rawSql:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT split_part(run_id, '_', 1) || '_' || split_part(run_id, '_', 2) AS run_group,
         approach,
         COALESCE(device, 'unknown') AS device,
         COUNT(*) AS n,
         AVG("rougeL") AS rouge_l,
         AVG(quality_score) AS quality,
         AVG(COALESCE(time_to_response, generation_time + COALESCE(retrieval_time, 0))) AS ttr
  FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (run_id, approach, sample_id, COALESCE(device, 'unknown'))
         *
  FROM evaluation_metrics
  ORDER BY run_id, approach, sample_id, COALESCE(device, 'unknown'), timestamp DESC
) evaluation_metrics
  WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL
    AND split_part(run_id, '_', 1) || '_' || split_part(run_id, '_', 2) IN (${run:sqlstring}, ${baseline_run:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT CASE sel.approach
           WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'Baseline'
           WHEN 'baseline_gguf' THEN 'Baseline (GGUF)'
           WHEN 'rag' THEN 'RAG'
           WHEN 'rag_gguf' THEN 'RAG (GGUF)'
           WHEN 'fine_tuned' THEN 'Fine-tuned'
           WHEN 'fine_tuned_with_rag' THEN 'Fine-tuned + RAG'
           ELSE sel.approach END AS approach,
       sel.device,
       sel.n AS n_selected,
       base.n AS n_compared,
       ROUND(sel.rouge_l::numeric, 3) AS rouge_l,
       ROUND((sel.rouge_l - base.rouge_l)::numeric, 3) AS d_rouge_l,
       ROUND(sel.quality::numeric, 3) AS quality,
       ROUND((sel.quality - base.quality)::numeric, 3) AS d_quality,
       ROUND(sel.ttr::numeric, 2) AS ttr_sec,
       ROUND((sel.ttr - base.ttr)::numeric, 2) AS d_ttr_sec
FROM agg sel
JOIN agg base
  ON base.run_group = ${baseline_run:sqlstring}
 AND sel.approach = base.approach
 AND sel.device = base.device
WHERE sel.run_group = ${run:sqlstring}
ORDER BY CASE sel.approach
           WHEN 'baseline' THEN 1
           WHEN 'baseline_gguf' THEN 2
           WHEN 'rag' THEN 3
           WHEN 'rag_gguf' THEN 4
           WHEN 'fine_tuned' THEN 5
           WHEN 'fine_tuned_with_rag' THEN 6
           ELSE 7 END, sel.device
